title: Components of a Sales Contract - Quiz

questions.text: What is a sales contract?
options: An agreement between employer and employee
An agreement between a buyer and a seller regarding the exchange of goods or services for a price
A rental agreement for real estate
An agreement for providing services without compensation
questions.correctAnswer: An agreement between a buyer and a seller regarding the exchange of goods or services for a price

questions.text: How many essential elements must be agreed upon in a sales contract?
Which of the following are legally required components of a sales contract?
options: Buyer and seller, quality, quantity, price
Delivery terms, payment terms, reservation of ownership
Only price and quantity
General terms and conditions, warranty, right to exchange
questions.correctAnswer: Buyer and seller, quality, quantity, price

questions.text: The parties to a sales contract can only be companies.
questions.correctAnswer: False

questions.text: What are fungible products?
options: Products that are individually produced and unique
Products where the characteristics of all items are the same and are interchangeable
Used products
Products with special brands
questions.correctAnswer: Products where the characteristics of all items are the same and are interchangeable

questions.text: Which is an example of a non-fungible product?
options: An iPhone 16
A DIN A4 exercise book
A used car
Standard tiles
questions.correctAnswer: A used car

questions.text: Which method of quality determination is recommended for used items?
options: Inspection
Samples and prototypes
Standards and quality classes
Brands and types
questions.correctAnswer: Inspection

questions.text: What does 'sale on approval' (Kauf auf Probe) mean?
options: The buyer can return the product within a specified period
The buyer receives a free sample to test
The buyer must keep the product
The seller only delivers samples
questions.correctAnswer: The buyer can return the product within a specified period

questions.text: What is the difference between 'sale on approval' and 'trial purchase'?
options: No difference - both terms mean the same thing
Sale on approval = conditional purchase with right of return; trial purchase = unconditional purchase without right of return
Trial purchase is more expensive
Sale on approval only applies to electronics
questions.correctAnswer: Sale on approval = conditional purchase with right of return; trial purchase = unconditional purchase without right of return

questions.text: What does 'specification purchase' mean?
options: The price is determined based on quality
The quality is only roughly specified and later determined by the buyer
The purchase is made only according to sample
The purchase applies to all products of a brand
questions.correctAnswer: The quality is only roughly specified and later determined by the buyer

questions.text: What is a 'giveaway' (Draufgabe)?
options: A smaller quantity than ordered is charged
An uncharged additional quantity beyond the ordered amount
A type of packaging
A form of payment
questions.correctAnswer: An uncharged additional quantity beyond the ordered amount

questions.text: What is net weight?
options: Total weight including packaging
Weight of the product alone, excluding packaging
Weight of packaging alone
Weight after all deductions
questions.correctAnswer: Weight of the product alone, excluding packaging

questions.text: What does 'non-binding price' mean?
options: The price cannot be changed later
The price is not yet finally fixed and may change
The price is only valid for a limited time
The price is legally prescribed
questions.correctAnswer: The price is not yet finally fixed and may change

questions.text: Which is an example of a 'non-binding price'?
options: Fixed price of 100 EUR
Market or stock exchange price
Price according to price list
Fixed price
questions.correctAnswer: Market or stock exchange price

questions.text: What is a 'quantity discount'?
options: A discount for new customers
A discount for larger purchase quantities
A discount for cash payment
A discount for loyal customers
questions.correctAnswer: A discount for larger purchase quantities

questions.text: Cash discount (Skonto) is a price reduction granted regardless of the payment date.
questions.correctAnswer: False

questions.text: Calculation: Payment terms '8 days with 3% cash discount, otherwise 30 days net'. If the invoice amount is 950.00 EUR, what is the cash discount amount?
options: 9.50 EUR
3.00 EUR

questions.text: What is the 'net purchase price' (Einstandspreis) in purchase price calculation?
options: The supplier's list price
The price after deducting discount and cash discount, plus procurement costs
The selling price to end customers
The gross price including VAT
questions.correctAnswer: The price after deducting discount and cash discount, plus procurement costs

questions.text: Calculate the net purchase price: List purchase price: 285.00 EUR, Supplier discount: 20%, Supplier cash discount: 2%, Procurement costs: 20.50 EUR. What is the net purchase price?
What does 'ex works' mean?
options: The seller bears all transport costs to the buyer
The buyer bears transport costs and risk from the seller's premises
The goods are delivered shipping-free
The goods are delivered directly from the manufacturer
questions.correctAnswer: The buyer bears transport costs and risk from the seller's premises

questions.text: What does 'free house' mean?
options: The buyer picks up the goods themselves
The seller bears transport costs and risk up to the buyer's destination
The goods are delivered free of charge
No shipping costs apply
questions.correctAnswer: The seller bears transport costs and risk up to the buyer's destination

questions.text: In a 'fixed-date transaction' (Fixgeschäft), delivery must occur exactly at the agreed time.
questions.correctAnswer: True

questions.text: What is the place of payment without contractual agreement?
options: The buyer's residence
The creditor's (seller's) residence or business premises
The buyer's bank
The bank's headquarters
questions.correctAnswer: The creditor's (seller's) residence or business premises

questions.text: What does 'credit purchase' mean?
options: Payment before delivery
Payment on delivery
Payment after delivery with payment term
Cash only payment
questions.correctAnswer: Payment after delivery with payment term

questions.text: What is a 'reservation of ownership'?
options: The buyer becomes owner as soon as the goods are delivered
The seller remains owner until the purchase price is fully paid
The buyer cannot resell the goods
The goods belong to the bank
questions.correctAnswer: The seller remains owner until the purchase price is fully paid

questions.text: When do General Terms and Conditions (AGB) become part of the contract?
options: Automatically with every purchase
Only if the company expressly draws attention to them and the customer has the opportunity to inspect them before concluding the contract
Only if they appear on the invoice
They never become part of the contract
questions.correctAnswer: Only if the company expressly draws attention to them and the customer has the opportunity to inspect them before concluding the contract

questions.text: General Terms and Conditions may be unclearly formulated as long as they are advantageous for the seller.
questions.correctAnswer: False
